seo_title: React2u, the personal occupational health service for employers and employees
seo_description: React2u is a personal occupational health service (arbodienst) in Eindhoven. One regular case manager for employers and employees, from prevention to reintegration.

blocks.label: One case manager who knows you. From day one to recovery.

lines: One case manager who knows you.
data.text: At React2u you do not get a phone menu. You get a regular case manager who knows your organisation and your people. From the first day of sickness to full recovery.

checks.text: No phone menu: you speak to one of us straight away
Medical information stays with the company doctor (bedrijfsarts)

photos.alt: A case manager talking with an employee at a table
Two colleagues looking at a screen together
Two employees talking on the work floor

data.heading: From staying healthy to getting back to work
data.text: We are not only there when someone is ill. From prevention and vitality to reintegration and career guidance: one partner, one regular contact.

steps.label: Prevent
steps.title: Healthy at work
steps.text: Risk assessment (RI&E), preventive medical examination (PMO), vitality and training.

steps.label: Spot early
steps.title: Acting before it becomes absence
steps.text: Coaching, a confidential adviser and help when someone is struggling, before they drop out.

steps.label: Support
steps.title: One contact when someone is ill
steps.text: Your regular case manager, the company doctor and every legal deadline (Wet verbetering poortwachter) taken care of.

steps.label: Move on
steps.title: Back to work or a new step
steps.text: Reintegration, second-track reintegration (tweede spoor) and career guidance with a fresh perspective.

data.heading:
